_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. ⚑ D23's TEACHING LIST (chunk 3b-ii): the fire line, now three separate one-grant options instead of one three-grant walk — clicking a row teaches that row and nothing else (D17). The 1/7/12 walls make hidden-when-known and locked-with-the-level-named both visible in a single screen, which is why this is the NPC to look at first. It also carries the other two branch shapes the PO brief asks for: a hint leaf (news) and a WoW-guard directions list. Prose is authored HERE, in JSON — the zone editor cannot reach it.
name: Emberkeeper

lines: Fire remembers who feeds it. Sit, if you like — the flame does not mind company.

options.text: Teach me something of the flame.

lines: What would you have of it? Speak plainly; fire has no patience for hedging.

grants.line: Let this be a light for you in dark places.

options.blockedLine: Fire doesn't suffer the careless. Grow stronger, then come to my flame.

grants.line: Let me show you how to light a fire in your enemies.

options.blockedLine: Fire doesn't suffer the careless. Grow stronger, then come to my flame.

grants.line: I can teach you how to burn everything around you. If you so desire.

lines: They burned this forest to hide their camp, and thought the ash would keep their secret.
Ash keeps nothing. Walk east far enough and you will smell them before you see them.
Speak the name. I have walked most of what is left.
Downhill, past the broken fence. The wheel still turns; nobody grinds anything.
North, where the hills close in. Take a light — the dark in there is the old kind, and it is patient.
Scattered. Sit at one and it remembers you; die far from it and you will find your way back.
